abstract: Digital transformation is quite a common word nowadays. Many businesses try to adapt to current society and improve by combining the usage of digital and technology because of easily collecting and analyzing data to improve their business process. The One Petroleum is also one of them. They try to incorporate the chatbot into managing and generating coupon processes. But some parts of these processes still require the labor of humans to perform and take more time. So, this project is developed in order to improve these processes to be more automatic, more digital and reduce the human labor and time spent. The project which we are developing will be divided into two major parts – LINE chatbot and Web Application – as well as the rework of coupon form. The project is developed by using Next.js framework and MongoDB to build the web app because of convenience and low budget in development to deploy on Vercel Server. And creating LINE chatbot by using LINE Developers Platform's Messaging API. The result of this project is that the site operator or business owner comment that some words on user interfaces are hard to understand or not relate in the real working environment. In conclusion, there are some benefits gained from implementing this project. The project can reduce the human work and time spent on generating and managing coupon processes. It also makes the processes to be more convenient as it allows employees to send pictures from the oil stations directly and business owners and check processes outside off the oil station's office. Lastly, it also provides a better data visualization on the information at hand better than a collection of paper coupons to count on.

category.label: Chatbot / conversational agent
category.evidence: The project is developed ... by creating LINE chatbot by using LINE Developers Platform's Messaging API, and the bot replies to commands typed in the LINE group.

technology.label: NoSQLBooster for MongoDB

technology.label: Ngrok
technology.evidence: We choose ngrok to perform as the webhook between our in-developed application to LINE server remotely during the development process.

technology.label: Visual Studio Code
technology.evidence: Why do we choose Visual Studio Code as our text editor? Because Visual Studio Code is a lightning-fast source code editor, perfect for day-to-day use.

technology.label: QR Code
technology.evidence: The new coupon will consist of QR-code for the bot to be able to retrieve data from when used coupons are taken a picture and are sent to the LINE group chat for the bot to detect it.

technology.label: npm
